title: Releases | What's new | Visa Product Design System

blocks.t: Learn about the latest version of the Visa Product Design System and the release history that got us here.

The Visa Product Design System team (VPDS) releases new additions and major improvements to its design and code libraries on a quarterly basis. Quarterly releases ensure VPDS maintains the highest standards of accessibility, usability, and aesthetic design. Each library is independently versioned following the semantic versioning standards.
Minor releases including bug fixes and patches happen continuously on an as-needed basis.

Nova is the latest version of VPDS. Complete with design kits in Figma and extensive code libraries, Nova is updated regularly to maintain the highest standards of accessibility, usability, and aesthetic design. To learn more, visit the changelogs for CSS, Flutter, React, Angular, or visit Latest news.
